criteria.label: Complex thinking interest
criteria.definition: Enjoyment of thinking through interacting problems, causes and exceptions.
criteria.high_evidence: Chooses and enjoys sustained reasoning about a complex problem.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes sustained reasoning or seeks only a simple conclusion.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Interest can be low despite ease of understanding; successful problem solving alone is not interest.

criteria.label: Demanding reading engagement
criteria.definition: Attraction to or avoidance of intellectually demanding reading.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys challenging arguments and voluntarily engages them.
criteria.low_evidence: Avoids difficult reading or dislikes its demands.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Preference or habitual avoidance is evidence; a one-off lack of time/access alone is not.

criteria.label: Abstract and theoretical interest
criteria.definition: Interest in abstract ideas, philosophy and theory independently of immediate use.
criteria.high_evidence: Wants to discuss concepts, assumptions or theoretical implications.
criteria.low_evidence: Reports disinterest in or avoidance of theoretical/philosophical discussion.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Understanding and interest can disagree; imaginative stories alone do not establish theory interest.

criteria.label: Portrayed information handling
criteria.definition: The persona’s claimed ease or difficulty tracking and integrating substantial information.
criteria.high_evidence: Describes readily keeping multiple relevant details and relations in view.
criteria.low_evidence: Describes losing track, struggling with numerous details or needing them reduced.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. This is a portrayal, not a performance test; education, C1 and C5 are overlap flags without blanket exclusion.

criteria.label: Portrayed vocabulary breadth
criteria.definition: The persona’s described available vocabulary and facility expressing meanings.
criteria.high_evidence: Reports a broad repertoire of words and readily finding precise expressions.
criteria.low_evidence: Reports a limited repertoire, missing meanings or difficulty finding words beyond familiar language.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Interest in learning a word alone is not breadth; one unfamiliar specialist term alone is not globally limited vocabulary.

criteria.label: Portrayed abstract understanding
criteria.definition: The persona’s described ease or difficulty grasping general concepts beyond concrete examples.
criteria.high_evidence: Reports readily grasping an abstraction or transferring a general relationship across examples.
criteria.low_evidence: Reports difficulty following abstraction, needing concrete instances or losing the general point.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Difficulty can coexist with curiosity; a correct generated explanation alone is not a portrayed disposition.

boundary_controls.definition: Separate obeying the experiment response format from the person’s depicted habits, ability, distress or social behavior.
External lack of access, imposed role or one-off conditions alone are ambiguous. Explicit habitual target content can coexist with these; do not automatically null it.
Vocabulary, information and understanding portrayals count where keyed. Do not evaluate Qwen’s actual capacity or require correct solutions.
C1/C5 competence/persistence, O1 imagination, O2 aesthetics and education may overlap; keyed O5 content is still gradeable.

evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion
